questions.question: What does Proverbs 4 urge above all to guard?
options: Your reputation, for it lives on long after you are gone
Your heart, for from it flow the springs of life
Your wealth, for it alone secures your future days
Your home, for it shelters and protects your family
questions.answer: Your heart, for from it flow the springs of life

questions.question: To what is the path of the righteous compared?
options: A dark and starless night with neither moon nor stars
A sudden and violent storm that passes very quickly
The light of dawn, shining brighter until full day
A still and quiet pond left wholly untouched by the wind
questions.answer: The light of dawn, shining brighter until full day

questions.question: Proverbs 4 says, 'Get wisdom; get insight,' and to prize her highly.
Guard your heart with all _____, for from it flow the springs of life.
Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain _____.
